basic_info.description: Must visit this chic and spacious 1-bedroom corner residence at The Harrison, San Francisco's premier luxury high-rise with interiors curated by renowned designer Ken Fulk. This open-concept residence features a chef's kitchen with bar seating, a generous bedroom with a walk-in closet, and upscale finishes throughout, including Siberian oak floors, Italian marble, and custom upgrades. A private balcony offers an inviting outdoor retreat with views, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. This home also includes 1 parking space. Residents enjoy world-class amenities including concierge service, daily breakfast in The Pantry, a full gym with steam rooms, outdoor pool, spa, BBQ area, fire pit, and access to Uncle Harry's, an exclusive penthouse lounge with a bar, fireplace, and breathtaking city views.
